description: Prerequisite gap analysis for the four IUT papers against Mathlib tag v4.36.0 (sources in .lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib). Every Mathlib declaration named here was checked with #check against the installed Mathlib, and its file is the module in which Lean reports it is declared; file paths are relative to the Mathlib source root. Entries for other Lean libraries are reported from their README files or file names and were not built or checked.
needed_by_method: Statement ids in needed_first_by come from pages read in this pass where the notes say so, from statement titles where the notes say so, and otherwise from the mechanical index: the external_keys field of data/statements.json (bibliography keys found in the extracted text of each statement page span), taking the earliest statement per paper. The mechanical index is not a reading of the papers.

areas.name: Algebraic number fields and their completions

missing.item: A uniform interface identifying the completion of a number field at a finite place with a finite extension of Q_p as an instance of IsNonarchimedeanLocalField (not searched exhaustively).
The ring Zhat as a named object; modeled in this project as the product of the adicCompletionIntegers over the primes of Z.

areas.notes: Read: IUT I Definition 3.1 (a), pages 61 and 62 (a number field containing a square root of -1, an algebraic closure, valuation sets); IUT IV Definition 1.9, pages 21 and 22.

areas.name: Local and global class field theory

mathlib.content: Tate cohomology of finite groups, an ingredient of cohomological class field theory

missing.item: Local reciprocity map and existence theorem for p-adic fields.
Global class field theory (idelic Artin map, reciprocity, existence).

other_lean_libraries.provides: local reciprocity, the Artin map for p-adic fields and the existence theorem, per its README
other_lean_libraries.caveat: Lean 4.32, not built here, cannot be imported

areas.notes: A plain text search of the Mathlib sources for "ClassField", "reciprocity" and "Artin" found no class field theory; the two "ClassField" hits are references, in module docstrings of TateCohomology/Basic.lean and RingTheory/Valuation/Discrete/Basic.lean, to external class field theory projects. Which IUT statements need class field theory was not determined from the pages read; the mechanical index shows [NSW] only in remarks and one example.

areas.notes: Infinite Galois theory with the Krull topology and the fundamental theorem for closed subgroups exists. IUT I Definition 3.1 (a), (c), pages 61 and 62 (read), uses the absolute Galois group of a number field and the image of its action on l-torsion points in GL_2(F_l).

areas.name: Valuations and normalized absolute values
areas.notes: The product formula exists in Mathlib; this project restates it over the valuation set of IUT IV Definition 1.9. IUT III Remark 3.12.1 (iii), pages 186 and 187 (read), refers to the product formula.

areas.name: p-adic logarithms and exponentials

missing.item: Convergence of NormedSpace.log on the disc of radius 1 over a complete ultrametric field, the homomorphism property, its extension to all units of a p-adic local field, and its image; these are listed as TODO items in the Mathlib file. Outside the region of convergence NormedSpace.log takes a junk value, so it is not yet the p-adic logarithm of the papers. The p-adic radius of convergence of NormedSpace.exp was not found either.

Log-shells: IUT III Definition 1.1 (page 24, rendered and read) defines the log-shell as (p_v*)^{-1} times the pre-log-shell, the image under the p_v-adic logarithm of the Galois invariant units, with p_v* = p_v for p_v odd and p_v* = p_v^2 for p_v = 2, citing [AbsTopIII], Definition 5.4 (iii).

other_lean_libraries.provides: the p-adic logarithm of a complete discretely valued field of characteristic 0 and normalized Haar log-volume, per its README
other_lean_libraries.caveat: Lean 4.32, not built here, cannot be imported

other_lean_libraries.provides: a log-shell defined as (2p)^{-1} log of the principal units
other_lean_libraries.caveat: Lean 4.32, not built here, cannot be imported. By an elementary argument not formalized here this is the same set as on IUT III page 24: log of the units equals log of the principal units, which is a Z_p-module, and 2p differs from p* by a unit when p is odd and equals p* = 4 when p = 2

areas.notes: Mathlib v4.36.0 defines NormedSpace.log for any topological Q-algebra, hence for Q_p, with only its algebraic properties at 1. The log-shell was therefore not formalized. IUT3.Prop3_9 and IUT4.Prop1_2 are cited from their titles (Log-volume for Packets and Processions; Differents and Logarithms).

areas.name: Szpiro-type and Vojta-type inequalities

missing.item: Szpiro and Vojta type inequalities over number fields: open conjectures in general. IUT IV Corollary 2.3 (title: Diophantine Inequalities; not read in this pass) is where the papers state Diophantine inequalities as consequences of the theory. Whether that derivation is valid is the disputed point; nothing here takes a position.

areas.notes: These are targets of the papers, not prerequisites; they must never enter the library as assumptions of unconditional results.

areas.name: Set-theoretic foundations and universe management

missing.item: The existence axiom (dagger G): every set lies in a Grothendieck universe. Not a theorem of ZFC; the paper assumes it (IUT IV page 67) and leaves the existence of ZFCG-models aside, citing Feferman (page 68).
No Grothendieck universe on ZFSet is exhibited (for example the image of ZFSet.{u} inside ZFSet.{u+1}); Mathlib has the embedding only at the PSet level (PSet.embed).
Species, set-theoretic formulas, and absoluteness of formulas between universes (IUT IV Definition 3.1 and page 68); needs a formal syntax for set-theoretic formulas.

areas.notes: Read: IUT IV pages 67 and 68. A search for "GrothendieckUniverse" in Mathlib declaration names found nothing.

infeasible_candidates.reason: Mathlib v4.36.0 defines NormedSpace.log, but without convergence on the disc, the homomorphism property, or the extension to all units (open TODO items in Analysis/Normed/Algebra/Logarithm.lean). Defining the log-shell faithfully (IUT III Definition 1.1, page 24) needs these. Replacing the log-shell by Z_p for p odd would be a shell and was not done.

infeasible_candidates.candidate: Pull-back invariance deg(a|_K) = deg(a) of IUT IV Definition 1.9 (i)
infeasible_candidates.reason: The paper defines the pull-back only "in the evident fashion"; choosing the pull-back so that the identity holds would make it nearly definitional. Deferred until the convention is fixed from [GenEll], section 1, which was not read.

infeasible_candidates.candidate: Degree zero of principal arithmetic divisors
infeasible_candidates.reason: Not defined on the pages read (IUT IV pages 21 to 23); with the archimedean weight 1 of Definition 1.9 (i) the coefficient convention at complex places would have to be chosen. Only the product formula itself was formalized.

infeasible_candidates.candidate: Existence of a Grothendieck universe in ZFSet.{u+1}
infeasible_candidates.reason: Mathlib has the embedding only at the PSet level (PSet.embed); building it for ZFSet and checking axioms (i) to (v) is a separate task.

external_repository.summary: Read only. Its README states a proof of an implication from a variant of IUT III Corollary 3.12 to the abc conjecture, with the variant itself not proved. It depends on fifteen further Lean libraries, cloned under documentation/external/lana-deps. None of this can be imported here because of the toolchain difference; statements and definitions would have to be ported and rechecked.
